text:
People Ops: Quick heads-up — we’re adjusting the Inference Ops structure to separate runtime delivery from model onboarding. This is to reduce handoff friction and speed up rollouts. Effective next week: a small TPM-led pod will own delivery coordination and infra handoffs. Meera Patel will join that pod as Technical Program Manager, Inference Ops. She starts Monday and will lead the handoff playbook and cross-team runbooks. :tada:
Meera Patel: excited to join — hi everyone! i’ll set up 1:1s and a short shadow schedule this week.
Ash Sinha: welcome Meera — huge help here. plan is for Meera to report to Runtime Delivery PMs for now and partner closely with Model Onboarding.
Lizzy Mendoza: onboarding checklist ready — will share access to the private deploy playbook and the infra runbooks. Meera, you’ll have SSO + infra perms by EOD Friday.
Dax Wong: is there a defined backfill plan for the model onboarding PMs who shift time? want to make sure we keep continuity for active enterprise customers.
People Ops: good q. We’ll stand up a 6-week shadow rotation. Two interim backfills: Carlos R. will cover priority enterprise handoffs, Elena will cover evaluation/evals backlog. We’ll open an IC 3 contract band for temporary capacity if needed.
Carlos R.: can confirm — will take the first two enterprise handoffs next week. posting a short org matrix in Confluence now.
Elena Morozova: happy to help with evals and regression monitoring. Meera, i can walk you through the quality gating process Tues morning.
Meera Patel: thanks all — appreciate the quick ramp. can someone share the routing policy doc and the model-variant fallback matrix?
People Ops: link: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/l/cp/InferenceOps-structure (internal). includes routing-policy.md and fallback-matrix.csv.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome email and access checklist sent to Meera Patel.
Ash Sinha: tiny ask — we’ll do a short announcement to customers using the dedicated beta who might see owner changes for support tickets. People Ops / Lizzy can coordinate.
Lizzy Mendoza: will draft a customer note and share for review.
Meera Patel: putting up a short 30-min sync for Weds 10am PT to walk through the handoff playbook and the shadow rotation calendar. invite going out now.
People Ops: thanks everyone — tagging folks who touched this: @Ash @Lizzy @Carlos @Elena. :thumbsup:
